description:
End-to-end photovoltaic demo: master data for a small PV plant (inverter,
battery storage, two module strings, two energy meters) plus the two-adapter
DataFlow that feeds it.

  Edge Pipeline  - polls the inverter over Modbus, scales the raw registers
                   and buffers a minute of readings onto the event hub.
  Mesh Pipeline  - turns each reading into entity updates, archives them and
                   applies the latest value to the entities.

Prerequisites on the tenant: Communication enabled (supplies the Mesh Adapter
this blueprint targets) and Stream Data enabled plus archives configured for
the metered attributes - SaveStreamDataInArchive@1 needs them.

The Edge pool and the Modbus adapter ARE seeded here: an edge adapter runs
next to the hardware and is not provided by the platform. Its pipeline
service account is provisioned automatically after the apply (AB#5111).
Point the ReadModbusRegister server address at your own device before
deploying - the seeded 192.168.14.31 is the address of the original demo
installation.

Deploy the DataFlow after installing.

Demo and training tenants only.
